name: Curated Target Within Genetically Implicated Process (Full Descendant Control)
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when Chemical causally affects gene in the decreased direction for activity, activity_or_abundance The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral.; The pharmacologic target acts upstream of or within the genetically associated process The pinned descendant closure is biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within, biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within_negative_effect, biolink:acts_upstream_of_or_within_positive_effect. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The biological process has a forward genetic association to the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:genetic_association. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.
hypothesis: A curated drug target can intervene within a genetically implicated process without being a directly associated gene.

derived_features.name: complete curated causal drug-target access path
derived_features.definition: A stored Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct relationship exists for a causes-qualified member of the full affects descendant closure with ChEMBL, Guide to Pharmacology, or DrugCentral primary-source support.
inputs: The full pinned affects descendant closure on Drug-to-GeneOrGeneProduct edges
derived_features.construction: Filter raw edges by causes qualification and any of the three sources, group by canonical endpoint pair, count distinct raw relationship identities, and merge one compact relationship per pair. Missing qualifiers or source arrays do not qualify. The rule uses only presence, then rematches raw edges with its recorded exact predicates, qualifiers, and sources. Removing the initial access-path MATCH and WITH before the marked comment gives the otherwise identical unmaterialized query.
derived_features.formula: compact presence iff count(distinct qualifying raw relationship)>0
derived_features.interpretation: This is a query acceleration, not a prediction threshold or an extra biological condition. Full-closure and exact-filtered target rules both rematch their own raw evidence. No training or held-out treatment labels define the access path.

mechanism.rationale: A curated drug target can intervene within a genetically implicated process without being a directly associated gene. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[compact:MINER_R0004_CURATED_TARGET]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE compact.artifact_id='r0004-curated-causal-target-v1' WITH DISTINCT chemical,gene /* END CURATED ACCESS PATH */ MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[target:{{relationship_types:target}}]->(gene:GeneOrGeneProduct) WHERE target.predicate IN {{predicates:target}} AND target.qualified_predicate = "biolink:causes" AND target.object_direction_qualifier = "decreased" AND target.object_aspect_qualifier IN ["activity","activity_or_abundance"] AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl","infores:gtopdb","infores:drugcentral"] WHERE source IN coalesce(target.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[upstream:{{relationship_types:upstream}}]->(process:BiologicalProcess) WHERE upstream.predicate IN {{predicates:upstream}} MATCH (process:BiologicalProcess)-[association:{{relationship_types:association}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE association.predicate IN {{predicates:association}} AND any(source IN ["infores:geneticskp"] WHERE source IN coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT process) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: target: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl, infores:gtopdb, infores:drugcentral; association: enforce primary-source membership in infores:geneticskp

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Source assertions lack dose, exposure, clinical context, and experimental causal validation.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition and is classified as treatment-using even if no such edge satisfies the other constraints in this graph.
